mapper.insert: INSERT INTO v_to_v ( request_user_id, response_user_id, call_range, call_time, call_position, target_position, call_longitude, call_latitude, target_longitude, target_latitude, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{requestUserId}, #{responseUserId}, #{callRange}, #{callTime}, #{callPosition}, #{targetPosition}, #{callLongitude}, #{callLatitude}, #{targetLongitude}, #{targetLatitude}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE v_to_v SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE request_user_id = #{requestUserId} AND status IN (0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.request_user_id, v.response_user_id, v.call_range, v.call_time, v.call_position, v.target_position, v.call_longitude, v.call_latitude, v.target_longitude, v.target_latitude, v.status, v.create_time, v.update_time FROM v_to_v v WHERE v.status = 0

SELECT v.id, v.request_user_id, v.response_user_id, v.call_range, v.call_time, v.call_position, v.target_position, v.call_longitude, v.call_latitude, v.target_longitude, v.target_latitude, v.status, v.create_time, v.update_time FROM v_to_v v WHERE v.id = #{callId}
mapper.update: UPDATE v_to_v SET response_user_id = #{responseUserId}, target_position = #{targetPosition}, target_longitude = #{targetLongitude}, target_latitude = #{targetLatitude}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emergency_call ( request_user_id, type, response_admin_id, call_range, call_time, call_position, call_longitude, call_latitude, target_position, target_longitude, target_latitude, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{requestUserId}, #{type}, #{responseAdminId}, #{callRange}, #{callTime}, #{callPosition}, #{callLongitude}, #{callLatitude}, #{targetPosition}, #{targetLongitude}, #{targetLatitude}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE emergency_call SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE request_user_id = #{requestUserId} AND status IN (0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS callId, e.type AS callType, e.call_time AS callTime, e.status AS status, e.response_admin_id AS responserId, a.name AS responserName, e.call_position AS callPosition, e.target_position AS targetPosition, e.target_longitude AS targetLongitude, e.target_latitude AS targetLatitude, e.call_longitude AS callLongitude, e.call_latitude AS callLatitude FROM emergency_call e LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON e.response_admin_id = a.id WHERE ( (#{userId} IS NOT NULL AND e.request_user_id = #{userId}) OR (#{adminId} IS NOT NULL AND e.response_admin_id = #{adminId}) ) AND e.status NOT IN (2, 3) -- 只查询活跃的呼叫（非已完成、非已取消） ORDER BY e.call_time DESC LIMIT 1 -- 取最新的一条记录
